scenes.say: Ever wonder if your app's dependencies are secure? How do you actually check for vulnerabilities?

scenes.label: Security
scenes.sub: Scanning finds known issues before release.
scenes.say: Scanning dependencies helps catch known security problems before you ship your code.

scenes.title: Maven & Gradle Commands
scenes.say: With Maven, run the OWASP dependency check command. In Gradle, use the dependency check analyze task. Both scan your dependencies for vulnerabilities.

rows.b: Run scan in your CI pipeline

scenes.say: Here's how I do it: add the plugin, automate scans in the build pipeline, and review the report for security alerts.

scenes.question: Is manual scanning enough?
scenes.right: No, automate scans in CI to catch issues fast.
scenes.say: Don't fall for this: manual scans aren't enough. Interviewers want to hear that you automate vulnerability checks in your continuous integration pipeline.
